name: Initial repository setup
description: Default setup issues generated for a new repoforge repository.

issues.title: task: verify generated scaffold

body.summary: Confirm the generated repository is complete, variables are replaced, and local verification passes.

sections.heading: Expected Blast Radius
items: Documentation, package metadata, and generated workflow files only.
Risk level: low unless repository-specific secrets or deployment settings are added.

checklist: Run `rg '\{\{[A-Z0-9_]+\}\}'` and replace any unintended placeholders.
Confirm README, LICENSE, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, and AGENTS instructions match the project.
Return a review pack with verification output and remaining decisions.

issues.title: task: prepare first release checklist

body.summary: Prepare the repository for its first tagged release without publishing until a maintainer approves.

sections.heading: Scope
items: Review changelog, roadmap, package metadata, and release process docs.
Do not publish packages, create secrets, or change production configuration.

checklist: Confirm package name, license, and repository URLs.
Confirm release checklist steps are project-specific.
Identify required human decisions before the first release.
Document rollback notes for any release automation that will be enabled later.

issues.title: task: triage template fit

body.summary: Review generated defaults and remove anything that does not fit this repository.

sections.heading: Out Of Scope
items: No CI or deployment changes unless a maintainer opens a separate task.

checklist: Review issue templates and PR template for project fit.
Review security policy and disclosure instructions.
Review docs and examples for claims that do not match current implementation.
Open follow-up issues for any non-trivial removals or rewrites.
